title: Panera Bread Coupons
description: Learn guitar chords for FREE through our new game Chord Master: http://bit.ly/ChordMasterYT Ask Panera Bread for a deal: http://askforadeal.com  Ask For a Deal allows you to request deals and find coupons for your favorite products and services.   Connect with us: Twitter: http://twitter.com/askforadeal Facebook: http://facebook.com/askforadeal  * * *  Nothing quite hits the spot like an excellent loaf of fresh baked bread. Panera Bread coupons can help you save money on their baked goods and a number of other great food items available through the restaurant.   Panera Bread was founded in 1981 and the cafe chain has over over 1,400 locations in the U.S. The company specializes in fresh baked bread, desserts, pastries, salads and various lunch items.   Start compiling savings by visiting the Panera Bread website. You can gain a variety of coupons and other deals by registering a Panera card on the site. You can order a card online or in a retail location. Click on the tab marked "Register Your Card". If you do, you'll be privy to savings available exclusively to members of the MyPanera community, like complimentary snacks.  Next, you can take a look at all the deals on offer at MyPanera.com.  You should also check out the cafe brand on Facebook or follow them on Twitter, as these affiliated pages are updated regularly by Panera. Promotional deals and coupons are posted here, and followers are often amongst the first to hear about deals like free samples of new items.  The brand also hosts a YouTube channel that contains a number of ads and other promotional videos and, occasionally, a coupon or two.   Coupons can also be found in your local newspaper or coupon insert if you have a Panera in your area.  For more coupons, deal saving opportunities and to request your own deals head over to http://askforadeal.com.  Connect with Panera Bread Homepage: http://www.panerabread.com/ Twitter: http://twitter.com/panerabread/ Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/panerabread YouTube: http://www.youtube.com/user/PaneraBreadCo

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Panera Bread products and coupons as an ordinary restaurant promotion focused on saving money on menu items. It describes registering a Panera card and checking Panera's website, social pages, and newspaper inserts to find deals, with no described payment demand, credential theft, deceptive return promise, or transaction outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary loyalty and promotion flow: coupons and deals are offered for Panera products, and the source describes registering a Panera card to access additional deals and complimentary snacks.
